page.layout: Running head across the top, centred: "SULPICII SEVERI SACRAE HISTORIAE", then "LIB. I." as a division heading. Below them one text column with a large woodcut initial R at its left, and a narrow marginal column of notes on the right. Under the text: the signature "A 2".

main_text.head: LIB. I.
main_text.p: Præfatio.RES a mundi exordio sacris literis editas breviter constringere, & cum distinctione temporum usq; ad nostram memoriam carptim dicere aggressus sum: multis id a me studiose efflagitantibus{a}, a Flagi-tantibus. Col.qui divina, compendiosa lectione, cognoscere properabant. Quorum ego voluntatem secutus, non peperci labori meo, quin ea, quæ permultis voluminibus perscripta continebantur, duobus libellis concluderem: ita brevitati studens, gesta narravit, siue ta filuit.[?]ut poene nihil gestis subduxerim. Visum autem mihi est non absurdū, cum usq; ad Christi crucem, Apostolorum q; actus per sacram historiam cucurrissem, etiam post gesta cōvertere{*}: excidium Hierosolymæ, *cōnesfle-[?]re Gu.prō bo. Vide notas.{b}vexationes populi Christiani, & mox pacis{3} tempora, ac rursum ecclesiarum intestinis periculis turbata omnia locutu-b perfectiō-tiones.rus. Ceterum illud non pigebit fateri, me, sicubi ratio exegit, ad distinguenda tepo-

page.notes: Doubtful or damaged: the drop-cap R is clear, but the line "gesta narravit, siue ta filuit" in the margin is hard to read at its end ("filuit"), so marked [?]. The asterisk note beside "excidium" begins with a word I cannot read securely ("cōnesfle-"), marked [?]. The reference mark "3" before "pacis" has no matching note on this page. The word "Col." in the margin beside "tantibus" is printed as shown and may be a truncated reference. The running head has "SVLPICII" printed with a V, transcribed as SULPICII under the u/v rule. Printed "ficubi" is read as "sicubi" (long s). The line-end "tepo-" continues on the next page, so the hyphen is kept.
